facts.fact: Jamhuriya University of Science and Technology, with the University of Djibouti, launched the Somali-language AI and Innovation Lab (SAIL) on 7 April 2026, and its researchers unveiled the SomBERTa model for detecting fake Somali news at 98 per cent accuracy, said to be available to media organisations and policymakers soon.
